The *Ajagaraṅgapañha* ("The Rock-Snake") is a section of the *Milindapañha* belonging to its seventh book of simile-based enquiries [Catalog; SuttaCentral]. In this section, the qualities or characteristics (*aṅga*) of the rock-snake or boa (*ajagara*) are examined as spiritual qualities to be cultivated by a Buddhist practitioner [Catalog; SuttaCentral]. SuttaCentral connects the text with the *Sāriputtattheragāthā* (Thag 17.2), which contains a parallel or related verse on the attributes of the rock-snake, and notes three modern translations across three languages [SuttaCentral].
